label: structural presentation
definition: A Presentation has state : Context → State, decode : Context → State → Form, and target : Context → Form. At a context c its output is decode c (state c). The target is supplied independently; its value does not assert occurrence, aboutness or actual existence. Context, state and form are mathematical carriers, not complete definitions of intrinsic being or intentional form.
note: Analyst structural meaning for #1380; see docs/notes/form-selection-1380.md. Mathematical fields have explicit bodies. Physical reference-fixing, intentional norms, cognitive adequacy and divine applicability remain OPEN interpretation obligations. No new numbered cognitive sense or actual semantic theory is established.
